competing_explanation: The policy may have changed, the 30-day window may apply only from purchase rather than delivery, or standard items may be subject to exclusions.
hypothesis_statement: The current full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence states a different return window, different start date, or additional conditions that invalidate a 30-day full-refund window for standard items.
